Guide

rows.name: Junior ADU
rows.note: Up to 500 sq ft, inside the house

landscape.speak: In Santa Clarita, a junior ADU runs about sixty thousand dollars to one hundred twenty thousand dollars and up. A garage conversion, about one hundred thousand dollars to two hundred thousand dollars. An attached ADU, about one hundred sixty thousand dollars to three hundred thousand dollars. And a brand-new detached ADU runs about two hundred thousand dollars to four hundred thousand dollars and up.

landscape.say: What drives the price in Santa Clarita? City or county permit: stevenson Ranch & Castaic go through LA County. Hillside lots: grading, retaining walls & soils reports. Oak trees: protected oaks change where the ADU can go. Fire zones: 2025 maps grew the Very High zones. Utility runs: sewer laterals, trenching & panel upgrades. Kitchens & baths: finishes move the total most.

landscape.label: Rules to Know
landscape.title: Santa Clarita ADU rules to know

tiles.s: The most a city can require

landscape.speak: A few rules to know. A city can require no more than four-foot side and rear setbacks. A city has sixty days to act on a complete application. ADUs of seven hundred fifty square feet or less skip impact fees. And in Santa Clarita, the city's 2026 handout requires zero parking spaces for ADUs.
landscape.say: A few rules to know. A city can require no more than 4-foot side and rear setbacks. A city has 60 days to act on a complete application. ADUs of 750 square feet or less skip impact fees. And in Santa Clarita, the city's 2026 handout requires 0 parking spaces for ADUs.
